title: Finding gflow on unlabelled open graphs
summary: The one-way model of measurement-based quantum computing implements computations via successive adaptive single-qubit measurements on a resource graph state. This model has practical applications, particularly in photonics, and it is also useful as a theoretical tool e.g. for optimisation. Gflow is a necessary and sufficient condition for implementing certain one-way computations deterministically (in a suitable sense); it is also used in efficient translations from the one-way model to quantum circuits.
